knobs.name: MAPLOC_CONFIRM_TRAVEL
knobs.doc: At boot, how far the body must have moved between the window that nominated a candidate and the one that confirms it.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_HEAD_LEAD_MS
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_HEAD_LEAD_MS`, as robotd read it: 5 ms by default — with 0 the standing drift was +0.17/+0.22°/min, with 20 and 40 it turned negative (twin, 2026-09-16).

knobs.name: MAPLOC_HYP_LEAD
knobs.doc: How many hits the leading hypothesis must have over the runner-up before it is nominated.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_HYP_TRAVEL
knobs.doc: How far the body must have got from where it first saw a hypothesis before the hypothesis can be believed — the chord, not the path.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_LOCAL_AFTER_BOOT
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_LOCAL_AFTER_BOOT=0`: every loss on a resumed map searches the whole map with every hypothesis, as before 2026-09-28.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_LOOP_CAP_YAW
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_LOOP_CAP_YAW` overrides it, for measuring on the twin.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_LOOP_DEBUG
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_LOOP_DEBUG=1`: one line per accepted closure on stderr — the submaps, the correction it asks for, the match's residual and beams, the witnesses' spread — to tell the closures that turn a map wrong.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_MULTI_HYP
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_MULTI_HYP=0` turns the multi-hypothesis boot search off, for measuring against the single-best agreement it replaces.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_REST
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_REST=0`: no stand ever rests, as before the rest (2026-10-01).

knobs.name: MAPLOC_SHADOW
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_SHADOW=0`: no shadow map at boot.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_SHADOW_ASKS
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_SHADOW_EVERY_S` and `MAPLOC_SHADOW_ASKS` override them.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_SHADOW_EVERY_S
knobs.doc: How often the shadow asks, how many answers in a row must agree, and what an answer must be (the homecoming's adoption rule, see quack-nav's `HomecomingConfig`, measured on 27 replayed wakes: 626 of 655 right answers pas…

knobs.name: MAPLOC_VALLEY_CROSS
knobs.doc: Two valleys that cross resolve each other (see `Mapper::valley_blocks`); `MAPLOC_VALLEY_CROSS=0` for the valley test alone.

knobs.name: MAPLOC_WATCHDOG_RESCUE
knobs.doc: `MAPLOC_WATCHDOG_RESCUE=0`: the watchdog judges a window at the carried pose alone, as before 2026-09-28.

knobs.name: QK_ALIGN_KICK
knobs.read_as: 1 on, 0 off, else the mode's own

knobs.name: QK_ANCHOR_DROP_M
knobs.doc: Not beside a drop: a revisit there turns the duck round in the mouth of the passage it is entering.

knobs.name: QK_BACK_NO_STEP_M
knobs.doc: No blind step back at all with a booked drop this close to the body, whatever its bearing, on the trail or not (`QK_BACK_NO_STEP_M`).

knobs.name: QK_BACK_REORIENT
knobs.doc: `QK_BACK_REORIENT=0`: after the step back, head for the most open floor and walk a leg there, as before.

knobs.name: QK_BACK_S
knobs.doc: The step back: this gait needs about a second to start moving at all, so a shorter one moves nothing (measured); and no more often than this.

knobs.name: QK_BLIND_CONE_LANE
knobs.doc: The cone widens at short range to the lane's own angle — at 0.25 m a 12 cm lane is 26°, and a cube 0.25 m ahead at 18° inside the lane was outside the 15° cone, walked over and dragged 1.9 m (sideA016r, 2026-09-22).

knobs.name: QK_CLIFF_MARGIN_M
knobs.doc: Stop this far short of a drop's edge — farther than a wall's margin, because an edge is not a bump.

knobs.name: QK_CLOSE_LOOK
knobs.read_as: 1 on, 0 off, else the caller's default
knobs.doc: `QK_CLOSE_LOOK=0`: no close looks.

knobs.name: QK_COST_HUG
knobs.doc: `QK_COST_HUG=0` restores the flat price.

knobs.name: QK_DROP_INFLATE
knobs.doc: `QK_DROP_INFLATE` to measure.

knobs.name: QK_DROP_REACH_M
knobs.doc: `QK_DROP_REACH_M=0` goes back to points.

knobs.name: QK_EDGE_DISCRIMINATE
knobs.doc: `QK_EDGE_DISCRIMINATE=0`: every sensed drop goes on the books as a hole, as before.

knobs.name: QK_GUARD_ARC_FULL
knobs.doc: Turning costs little forward speed: 0.110 m/s at vyaw 0.7 against 0.121 straight, measured on the human drive (2026-09-07).

knobs.name: QK_INFLATE_M
knobs.doc: The inflation the planner runs with: 0.12, a little over the body's half-width, 0.10 (`QK_INFLATE_M`).

knobs.name: QK_LANE_YIELD_M
knobs.doc: `QK_LANE_YIELD_M`: [`LANE_YIELDS_TO_DROP_M`] for an experiment.

knobs.name: QK_NO_GUARDS
knobs.read_as: 1 on, 0 off, else the caller's default
knobs.doc: `QK_NO_GUARDS`: every leg, kick and pulse goes through `robot.move`, blind, and the route check is off — the planner alone (the frozen map, the books, the margins) brings the duck home.

knobs.name: QK_PULL_DEVIATION_M
knobs.doc: A straight run may stray this far from the Dijkstra route it replaces: the staircase is smoothed, the route is not redrawn — a diagonal across the room cut corners and brushed walls Dijkstra had kept away from (the user'…

knobs.name: QK_PULL_ROUTE
knobs.doc: `QK_PULL_ROUTE=0` leaves Dijkstra's staircase as it is.

knobs.name: QK_REACH_TO_FLOOR
knobs.doc: `QK_REACH_TO_FLOOR=0`: the reach behind a rim ignores where the floor comes back (see `record_drops`).

knobs.name: QK_REANCHOR
knobs.doc: `QK_REANCHOR=0`: no trip back to mapped floor now and then to close a loop while the exploration walks new floor (see the explorer's run).

knobs.name: QK_RIM_TOUR
knobs.read_as: 1 on, 0 off, else the caller's default
knobs.doc: `QK_RIM_TOUR=0`: no rounds of the holes.

knobs.name: QK_RL_POLICY
knobs.doc: `QK_RL_POLICY`: the pilot file (docs/rl-pilot.md) that flies the stick's legs;

knobs.name: QK_RL_TRACE
knobs.doc: `QK_RL_TRACE`: what the duck did and saw, leg by leg, for the calibration (`quack-rl`'s `rl_calib`, docs/rl-pilot.md).

knobs.name: QK_SPIN_WATCH
knobs.doc: `QK_SPIN_WATCH=0`: turn in place without watching the sensor, as before.

knobs.name: QK_STICK_CAREFUL
knobs.read_as: 1 on, 0 off, else the caller's default

knobs.name: QK_TRAIL
knobs.doc: Off with `QK_TRAIL=0`, for measuring.

knobs.name: QK_TRUSTED_FLOOR
knobs.read_as: 1 on, 0 off, else the mode's own

knobs.name: QK_TURN_IN_PLACE
knobs.doc: `QK_TURN_IN_PLACE=0` turns the old way (kick, then yaw) everywhere.
